title: Predictable generator use (dart) — review required
description: Code in dart draws from a non-cryptographic generator: Randoms*(s*). Output is predictable, so security values built on it can be guessed. This lexical rule flags the use; the reviewer confirms the value is non-security or switches to Random.secure().
remediation: Draw security values from Random.secure() instead.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the generator regardless of purpose. Argument-taking generator calls are separate rules.
